reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A fresh Core's default reserve admitted only the API and two project workers, a project with any open chat kept its worker forever, so a third project's request waited indefinitely, its held reason hid the memory refusal, and its queued command refused runtime-stop. The never-saved default reserve is now sized from host memory (an operator-saved policy is never changed), a project with active demand takes the memory of the least recently used resident that runs nothing, a project that cannot be served shows 'Waiting for memory' naming the residents and its unstarted requests fail after a bound, and a held workerless project's queued request no longer blocks host shutdown. Selected: the new capacity, sizing and knowledge regressions, plus the admission, retirement, quiescence, shutdown, view-lease, memory-budget, runtime-memory and API worker suites these paths touch, and the settings-catalog discovery test.
exclusions: test_runtime_memory_control.py, test_storage_alert_dispatch.py and test_product_knowledge.py each have one failure already present on clean main (unchanged by this branch) and are excluded; they ran locally with no new failures. No native layer: no Rust change. No Playwright: no UI component changed; the held reason and request error reach existing UI fields. Real-Core evidence (STUCK on main, PASS on the branch, restart and upgrade checks) is in the PR, not executed by CI. PostgreSQL variants run where NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is set; they passed locally.
